notes.text:
An update is available for kernel.
This update affects Rocky Linux 10.
A Common Vulnerability Scoring System (CVSS) base score, which gives a detailed severity rating, is available for each vulnerability from the CVE list
notes.title: Topic

notes.text:
The kernel packages contain the Linux kernel, the core of any Linux operating system.

Security Fix(es):

* kernel: libceph: make decode_pool() more resilient against corrupted osdmaps (CVE-2025-71116)

* kernel: libceph: prevent potential out-of-bounds reads in handle_auth_done() (CVE-2026-22984)

* kernel: libceph: replace overzealous BUG_ON in osdmap_apply_incremental() (CVE-2026-22990)

* kernel: Linux kernel: Denial of Service in libceph OSD client due to unreset sparse-read state (CVE-2026-23136)

* kernel: KVM: SEV: Require in-GHCB scratch area if GHCB v2+ is in use (CVE-2026-53360)

* kernel: bridge: mcast: Fix a possible use-after-free when removing a bridge port (CVE-2026-64032)

* kernel: iomap: guard io_size EOF trim against concurrent truncate underflow (CVE-2026-72367)

* kernel: platform/x86/amd/pmc: Fix LPS0 and debugfs leaks when STB init fails (CVE-2026-81015)

* kernel: media: cec: disable delayed work before freeing an interrupted transmit (CVE-2026-89899)

* kernel: uio: Fix stale info pointer in failed registration path (CVE-2026-93054)

* kernel: mm/hugetlb: preserve mremap address delta when skipping page tables (CVE-2026-98373)

* kernel: s390/boot: Avoid IPL parameter append past command line (CVE-2026-98403)

* kernel: net: openvswitch: conntrack: fix helper UAF due to extensions realloc (CVE-2026-98490)

* kernel: io_uring: fix task_work add use-after-free with SQPOLL (CVE-2026-98858)

* kernel: kernel: Privilege escalation via use-after-free in transparent huge page reclaim (CVE-2026-99463)

* kernel: kernel: privilege escalation via use-after-free in pagemap scan (CVE-2026-99477)

* kernel: kernel: memory corruption via duplicate global ASID allocation (CVE-2026-99592)

* kernel: kernel: Memory corruption via integer overflow in GUP-fast (CVE-2026-99661)

* kernel: kernel: privilege escalation via improper memory allocation in userfaultfd (CVE-2026-99580)

* kernel: kernel: memory corruption via improper VMA boundary merge (CVE-2026-99648)

Bug Fix(es) and Enhancement(s):

* bnxt_en: TX DMA overrun on padded small packets causes IOMMU faults and TX timeouts since kernel-6.12.0-211.64.1.el10_2 (exposed by Rocky Linux-254268); please backport upstream fix [rhel-10.3.z] (JIRA:Rocky Linux-300818)

For more details about the security issue(s), including the impact, a CVSS score, acknowledgments, and other related information, refer to the CVE page(s) listed in the References section.

This advisory is provided by Ctrl IQ, Inc for Rocky Linux systems. For more information about CIQ security practices, visit https://ciq.com/security.
